Subject: Question on staged offboarding + safekeep windows

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Two compliance threads came up internally that we need to resolve before procurement can sign:

1) We want a "safekeep" window after termination where customer-initiated rollbacks are possible — something like 90 days, but we need clarity about when the data actually becomes irretrievable.
2) We need a staged offboarding option: short-term hold for customer support (30 days), medium safekeep (90–180 days), and a long tail archival snapshot only accessible via escrow/forensics request. Can you confirm Redwood's capabilities and proposed order form language for each tier?

Also: do you offer a certified deletion attestation and what is your timeline for certified deletion once the safekeep period lapses? We need to present firm timelines to our security team.

Appreciate a short, actionable summary we can include in our contract (order form).

Best,

Hi Susan — thanks, great questions. Below is a concise proposal we can drop into the order form (SLA annex) and into DocuSign. I'm copying Ben and Laura for pricing and legal wording. If this looks good I'll produce a redline.

Proposed offboarding tiers (order-form friendly language):

- Tier A — Operational hold (supportable rollback): 30 days post-termination. During this period Redwood will retain encrypted customer data in active hot storage; customer may request restoration or rollback. Expected deletion action: customer-initiated restore available; standard purge/expunge procedures upon expiration.

- Tier B — Safekeep window (for regulatory & low-latency rollback): selectable 90 or 180 days per order form. Data will be moved to cold but retrievable storage with KV snapshot references; restoration requires a documented request and will be completed within the SLA time-to-restore window. After the safekeep window expires, Redwood will begin certified deletion procedures.

- Tier C — Escrow snapshot (for forensic or legal hold): single immutable snapshot stored in encrypted escrow for up to 540 days (optional add-on). Access is granted only upon mutual legal agreement or court order; retrieval requires 30 business days and an approved access request.

Certified deletion/attestation:
- Initiation: certified deletion process begins immediately after safekeep expiration or earlier at customer instruction.
- Purge timeline: logical purge asserted within 72 hours of initiation; physical/cryptographic erasure completed within 30 days (timeline depends on storage tier and replication footprint).
- Attestation: Redwood provides a signed Deletion Certificate (PDF) within 5 business days of completion.

Rollback & clawback protections:
- If customer requests rollback during safekeep window, Redwood supports a one-button restore flow for Tier A and a documented restore for Tier B within agreed timeframes.
- Order form includes a clause for emergency rollback (24–72 hour SLA) subject to additional one-time rehydration fees.

Operational notes:
- For Tier B, customers may elect immediate cryptographic tombstoning at any time (expedites irrecoverability).
- For Tier C escrow snapshots, Redwood will store snapshots encrypted with customer-managed keys (KMIP/KMS integration available) at an additional fee.

Attachments: I attached a short matrix summarizing options and costs.

If this covers your needs I'll convert the bullets to order-form language and produce the DocuSign package.

Cheers,

Hi Susan — thanks for the clarity. Per below we've drafted order-form-ready language (concise lines that can be inserted into the SLA annex). Key points: selectable safekeep (90/180), certified deletion timelines (72-hour logical purge, 30-day physical/crypto erasure, 5 business day attestation), and optional escrow snapshot.

Please review the bullets below and the attached PDF. If acceptable, sign the attached order form via DocuSign (link below) and we'll trigger the legal redline.

Order form excerpt (suggested):
- "Operational Hold (Tier A): Redwood will retain customer data in hot storage for 30 days following termination to allow for operational restores. Restores must be requested in writing and will be completed within 24–72 hours subject to system load."
- "Safekeep Window (Tier B): Customer may elect a safekeep period of 90 or 180 days. During this window, Redwood will retain customer data in cold retrievable storage. Upon expiry Redwood will initiate certified deletion as set forth below unless Customer requests an extension in writing."
- "Escrow Snapshot (Tier C - optional): Redwood will create a read-only encrypted snapshot and store in escrow for up to 540 days. Access requires mutual written agreement or court order."
- "Certified Deletion: Redwood will (i) initiate logical purge within 72 hours of deletion initiation; (ii) complete cryptographic/physical erasure within 30 calendar days; and (iii) provide a signed Deletion Certificate within 5 business days of completion."
